reviews.text: It's insane, they charge you just to breathe. It's crazy how they charge you for breathing.

As an area for improvement for the hospital, we do find it strange that, in addition to the cost of the consultation, tests, and other veterinary services, parking is also charged.

We go to other veterinary hospitals that also offer valet parking, and in those cases, they simply validate our ticket, and the hospital absorbs that cost. That's why it particularly caught our attention here that the charge is passed directly on to the client, when we consider this type of service to be part of the operating costs associated with the care and experience the hospital itself offers.

In our case, we continue to go because we greatly value the care, professionalism, and trust that Dr. Livier provides. If it weren't for the excellent experience we've had with her, we probably would have already considered going to another veterinary hospital.

We hope you can review this policy because we believe that absorbing or at least subsidizing parking would be an important detail within the overall experience you offer to pet owners and their pets.
Excellent Service

The facilities are spotless, and the service and medical care are top-notch. Thank you, Dr. Livier, for taking such excellent and loving care of our puppies. They love you, and their humans are grateful for your patience and treatment.

MERCENARIES: It's understood that it's a business, but they are completely opaque about hospitalization costs. Seeking profit in a business is one thing, but exploiting people who simply want to help their pets is another.
I highly recommend Hospivet for the quality and kind service they provided to my dogs, especially Dr. Livier for her professionalism, attention, and care in treating my pets. Thank you.
Good attention and excellent Dr. Livier Quezada

Yesterday I took my dog ​​in, and the care from the entire team, both medical and administrative, was exceptional.

The facilities are beautiful, and the quality of their services is excellent.

I want to especially thank and acknowledge Dr. Livier Delgadillo Quezada, who from the very beginning was very attentive, empathetic, kind, and understanding of my pet's situation. She is clearly an extremely well-prepared doctor, committed and dedicated to the health of her patients and to ensuring that their families feel supported, heard, and at ease at all times.

Thank you for everything 💚

I came to Hospivet del Valle because of Dr. Livier Quezada, who has been my dog's veterinarian for the past few years. The hospital's service, in general, has been excellent; all the staff are very kind and efficient.

Recently, my dog ​​had an accident and had to be hospitalized. They treated him very well, and above all, he recovered very quickly. They knew exactly how to treat him to pull him through, which is doubly valuable since he's a geriatric patient.

Dr. Livier is very professional. She has kept my dog ​​in excellent health, particularly by treating him preventively to avoid developing kidney disease. I trust her completely, and she always treats him with great skill, care, and love.
Dr. Livier Quezada has been very professional, always available to help and care for my pet with great compassion and professionalism; the results have been evident.

Highly recommended. Dr. Livier Delgadillo provided excellent care. Very professional and dedicated to Rocketta's follow-up. She treats her patients with responsibility and kindness. And she explains the condition and treatment plan to us, the owners, in detail.

Those of us who deeply love our animals know how difficult it is to find a veterinarian we can truly trust. As a healthcare professional and as a human deeply concerned for my puppies, I find it invaluable that Dr. Livier takes the time to listen, examine, and carefully and thoroughly before prescribing treatment.

In her, I found ethics, professionalism, and evidence-based decisions, without improvisation or unnecessary treatments.

In an environment where some practices can feel more commercial than medical [which is not the case with her], I appreciate that Franshesca and Cayetana are treated as important patients and not as a financial opportunity.

Thank you, Dr. Livier, for caring for them with such attention and for giving me peace of mind knowing they are in the hands of a professional truly committed to their well-being. I hope the hospital greatly values ​​having professionals like her.

As an area for improvement for the hospital, I believe it is important to reinforce the cleaning of the floors. Upon entering, they appear dirty, and it would be very helpful to have someone in charge of giving the cubicles a quick cleaning between consultations, especially since it is a space dedicated to the care of animals.
I've taken my dog ​​there a couple of times and they've always been very attentive and accurate in their diagnoses.
Marlene, we're so glad to hear your experience at Hospivet was positive! 💙 Thank you for trusting us and letting us take care of your little ones. 🐾 …

Here, it seems the priority is extracting as much money as possible from you, not actually caring for your pet. They focus heavily on the fees, but offer very little clarity in their communication and even less empathy.

We traveled from Cuernavaca because my dog's cytology was consistent with sarcoma, and we needed a CT scan. We weren't there for an initial diagnosis: we already had blood work done, including blood tests, hematology, ultrasound, X-rays, and cytology.

I explained over the phone on Tuesday that we needed the CT scan. They told me that an oncology evaluation was essential first and gave me the earliest available appointment: Sunday at 5:30 p.m. The consultation fee, $1,200, was perfectly clear from the phone.

The receptionist told me to send my dog's information and the cytology results via chat so the oncologist could review them. I did so. She never informed me that THEY DON'T OFFER CT SCAN SERVICES ON SUNDAYS.

The unpleasant surprise came when I saw the oncologist: she knew practically nothing about what I had explained on the phone and hadn't even received the cytology sample I'd been asked to send. I had to show it to her right then and there. The evaluation basically consisted of palpating the tumor, listening to its sounds, and reviewing the cytology sample I showed her. Finally, she essentially told us what we already knew: there's a mass consistent with sarcoma, and we need a CT scan.

And that's when we found out that it couldn't even be done that day because there are no CT scans on Sundays.

We made the trip from Cuernavaca, brought a dog with a tumor and in pain, followed all her instructions, paid for the consultation, and returned without having made any progress on the scan we came for. Anger mixed with sadness and helplessness.

The contradictory thing is that when it comes to discussing fees, they are very specific. We were informed that the consultation would cost $1,200, and while we were there, they even told us how much it might cost if my dog ​​needed resuscitation during a future CT scan. But when we asked how much the CT scan itself would cost, they couldn't give us a price, even though they already had his weight.

When we complained about the lack of information, the receptionist became defensive and claimed there was a chat service. I have that chat service too: it doesn't ask for any other tests, it doesn't clarify any other details about the procedure, and it certainly doesn't inform me that there are no CT scans on Sundays.

I don't question the existence of a protocol or that an oncologist should evaluate the patient beforehand. I question why they don't explain it clearly from the beginning. It would have been enough to say: "The evaluation costs $1,200 and is mandatory, but we don't do CT scans on Sundays, and you'll have to come back another day." We could have made a decision with that information.

When your pet has a cytology result consistent with cancer, you arrive already worried, sad, and uncertain. The last thing you need is incomplete information and a defensive attitude instead of empathy.

This isn't the first veterinary clinic or hospital I've had to go to, and I can say that this has been, by far, the worst service I've ever received.

Our experience: a huge focus on charging and very little on providing clear information, coordinating, and empathizing with your pet's situation and your family's.
A terrible experience. They misdiagnosed my dog ​​and prescribed a treatment that clearly didn't work, plus the service left much to be desired. I definitely don't recommend them.

I took my dog ​​in with stomach problems (bloody diarrhea). They took her temperature, and according to them, 39.7°C is normal for a senior dog (it isn't, another vet explained that to me). They did an ultrasound (which they refused to give me a copy of) and her intestine was inflamed, but they never considered an infection. The vet didn't want to prescribe antibiotics and only gave her pain medication and human loperamide (later I was told elsewhere that this wasn't recommended). They didn't resolve anything. They wanted to run tests for other things that were completely irrelevant (a lump on her leg that's already been diagnosed as a lipoma). To top it all off, the vet said he was just going to get the prescription and would be right back. He kept us waiting for 40 minutes, and in the end, it seemed he'd forgotten. And on top of all that, a Spanish guy arrived with his dog with the same symptoms. He didn't have an appointment, and they saw him immediately even though we were still in our appointments. Terrible experience, and they don't even have a system for receiving complaints or user feedback.
NO, THAT WASN'T HOW IT WAS. I WAS TOLD THAT THE FIRST STEP WAS THE ULTRASOUND, AND IF I WAS STILL UNSOUND, THE NEXT STEP WOULD BE BLOOD TESTS. I CAN GET THE REFERENCES MYSELF, BUT YOU ARE THE DOCTORS, AND THAT'S WHY I CAME TO YOU. EVEN THOUGH THE PRESCRIPTION STATES THAT I CAN RETURN (THAT'S OBVIOUS), COMPREHENSIVE CARE SHOULD HAVE BEEN PROVIDED FROM THE BEGINNING. YOU SHOULD CHECK WITH YOUR STAFF. I SEE VERY GOOD REVIEWS OF SOME DOCTORS, BUT THE ONE WHO SAW ME WAS DEFINITELY PREOCCUPYED BY SOMETHING ELSE.

I didn't take my dog ​​in for anything serious, so I can't really comment on the medical aspect. In that regard, the vet was very kind and handled the situation appropriately.

However, I'd like to mention that the security guard's behavior was as if you were going to steal from them, especially if you didn't have money to pay. Upon arrival, the first thing he warned us about was the cost of the consultation, something we never even asked. As we were leaving, he made comments and checked the receipt as if we were trying to steal something. Please improve communication between the veterinary staff and the security guard so you don't feel like a jerk or someone who's going to leave without paying. Just let each other know that payment has been made and that's it! The treatment and attitude were completely unacceptable.
Good service, highly recommended.
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating, Osvaldo! ⭐️💙 Our whole team really appreciates your trust. 🐾✨ …

Well, we haven't had a very good experience. They're getting more expensive and less good each time. When they first opened, they provided excellent service and their prices were affordable, but we've visited them three times now with our dogs, and the last time the vet treated us like we were idiots because of a slight inaccuracy in my wife's observation. But beyond that, they just want to sell you more treatments and specialized services, far beyond what's reasonably necessary, and you end up with bills of thousands of pesos for practically nothing. They were a good option for the neighborhood when they first arrived, but money has made them greedy, and they've abandoned any sense of service and the understanding that not everyone can afford exorbitant prices for every little thing.
It's a very tidy and clean place. The service is top-notch. They have annual health packages for dogs and cats.
Excellent attention and service!!! 👌 …

I highly recommend Hospivet. 🐾🤍

My little ones have been treated here, and I honestly couldn't be more grateful to the entire team. From the very first moment, they treated us with such warmth, empathy, and professionalism—something that makes all the difference for those of us who love our pets as part of the family.

They always take the time to explain each procedure, answer questions, and, above all, treat my little ones with so much love and patience. During difficult times for us, I've felt supported, listened to, and reassured knowing they're in very good hands.

You can tell when someone does their job with true dedication and love for animals, and at Hospivet, that's evident in every appointment.

Thank you for taking such loving, dedicated, and professional care of my little ones. Without a doubt, this is a place I highly recommend and to which I entrust something so important to me: the health of my babies. 🐶🤍✨

It was my favorite hospital to take my dog ​​to, and I trusted it completely: excellent doctors, kind, knowledgeable, and always available. Dr. Lorena, Dr. Isabel, and Drs. Rodrigo, Misael, Daniel, and Javier are all fantastic; you don't need to ask them to know they love their work.

Recently, they hired a doctor named Lumiere who, from the first day she saw us, did so reluctantly, as if she'd been working there for 10 years hating the place and life was demanding a change that hasn't happened yet. I put up with a lot of mistreatment for my dog's sake, so she could continue her treatment. She's completely unresponsive to questions: if you ask her something about the treatment, she doesn't see it as a patient's question, she sees it as an interrogation. She's arrogant; you ask her a question during a consultation, and you immediately see her face, clearly fed up with having to work and clarify a doubt for someone who isn't a veterinarian and doesn't understand technical language.

I sent him journal articles, and instead of providing technical arguments to explain his professional opinion for or against, he told me over the phone, in his own words, "Well, your journals might be great, but I have others that say different things," forgetting that he's a doctor, that he's speaking with the patient's legal representative, and treating me like we were drinking buddies or lifelong friends. Furthermore, when I sent him clinical trial journals with questions about the treatment, repeatedly clarifying that his opinion was the only one I considered, instead of responding with arguments about whether he agreed or disagreed, he told me that if I didn't feel comfortable, I could return her to the previous treatment, making his level of professionalism abundantly clear, even after I explained that it wasn't about doing whatever I wanted.

He raises his voice; his frustration is palpable. She should consider whether this career and caring for her patients' owners is truly what she wants in life, because if she doesn't change course, she'll never get anywhere, and her ego will only be fueled by badmouthing her colleagues' previous treatments and mistreating patients.

To the hospital owners: you should internally review whether these types of people fit the business model you want to build. Even if veterinary schools don't offer a course on "basic empathy for pet owners suffering the anxiety of a diagnosis," you should require basic patient and client education in your recruitment process.
Excellent service

It used to be our regular veterinary hospital, but they're constantly changing doctors, and we have to explain the treatment again and again, and the protocol changes every time. The treatment is unsustainable. They give me a price over the phone for a medication, and then when I pay, it goes up by about 10% because the application and syringe are separate. Before, they didn't make us wait so long; they respected the time. Now, just paying took 20 minutes because the doctor wouldn't send the total. And it was only one application of a medication that they started giving there every three months back in 2024.
A very good hospital, with excellent service and helpfulness. My dog ​​was hospitalized for four days for a respiratory condition, and he recovered very well.

Although the service is good, the wait is far too long. I arrived for an emergency at 6:30 am. They assessed me beforehand and told me I would be seen after the shift change. It wasn't until 8:22 am that one of the receptionists approached me to ask why we were waiting. I explained the situation, and she told us they didn't have any space and couldn't see us. They gave us an appointment for 1 pm with instructions that we would be seen immediately, but that didn't happen; we waited again for over an hour.
I really appreciated the service; they saved me during a stressful time.
Wonderful service! Even though there were many patients waiting, they were very quick and kind. The doctor explained everything very clearly and treated our puppy extremely well.

Terrible service 🐕‍🦺
Awful
Lies
They don't take care of the dogs
I would never recommend them
Why don't they tell you what they do to your dogs?

The staff's attention was generally good, the hospital was very clean, and the facilities were adequate for providing medical care. I took my dog ​​in for tummy trouble, and the doctors were very attentive and professional. Thanks to them, my dog ​​improved within a few hours. I highly recommend them.

BEWARE OF “DR.” RODRIGO, “DR.” DANIEL, AND “DR.” GERARDO!

The NEGLIGENCE at this place is extremely serious. Incorrect and alarmist diagnoses, tests upon tests to inflate bills to thousands of pesos, zero follow-up, and when you supposedly go for a general consultation, THEY CHARGE YOU AND DON'T EVEN DO ANYTHING. (No stethoscope, no touching the dog, no looking at its eyes.) Everything is done by guesswork.

While your dog could be in real danger, Rodrigo, one of the “veterinarians,” is laughing his head off while I'm overwhelmed by the test results, while “veterinarians” Daniel and Gerardo are figuring out how much more they can charge depending on how scared you are.

Money is NOT the problem. I'll pay anything for my dog. The problem is entrusting his health to those who call themselves “doctors,” giving them thousands of pesos, and discovering that, while they're getting paid, YOUR DOG REMAINS AT RISK BECAUSE OF THEIR NEGLIGENCE.

Thank you so much for your rating, Alejandra! We're here to serve you! 🐾💙⭐

 …
We are very happy with the attention and how handsome Lau makes my dog ​​look. Thank you for the great treatment you give my little one.

Their attention and care for my kitten Gazube has been incredible. Thank you so much for helping him pull through and for providing such wonderful care during a very difficult time for us.

The doctors and staff are amazing; I have such peace of mind knowing Gazube is in the best hands.
Excellent team and equipment overall, a bit of a bad attitude from management but a great place

Excellent service and attention. Very comprehensive. Specialists. Highly professional. Specialized clinics for cats and dogs. Excellent WhatsApp communication. Great human touch; they genuinely care about their patients, explain everything thoroughly, and are very patient.
Bad experience. The follow-up is a disaster and the doctor who treated me was rude.

DO NOT TAKE YOUR DOGS TO THIS CLINIC if you don't want to lose money due to misdiagnoses.

I'm leaving my review because I know how much our animals mean to us, and they only see it as a business. From what I can see, they're young people; I didn't see anyone with enough experience. That's just how these kinds of clinics are. Besides, the doctors rotate, so they don't really provide follow-up care.

My dog ​​has a regular vet, but one night I saw him in a lot of pain, not eating or drinking, so I took him to Hospivet. They told me he probably had a prostatic abscess and recommended hospitalizing him and doing an ultrasound.

The next day, they informed me that he had pancreatitis and possible brucellosis. My vet reviewed the results and told me that those diagnoses didn't match tests done just two days earlier, so he asked me to cancel the ultrasound and do it himself. Hospivet's diagnosis was prostatic abscess.

Hospivet told me the ultrasound was scheduled for 4:30 p.m. However, I returned about 15 minutes later to cancel it and was told it had already been done. This situation made me lose confidence in the procedure and the care I received.

I received the test results that same afternoon, even though I was told they would arrive in 5 days, and it turns out they didn't even do a prostate ultrasound.

I'm sharing my experience because I know the desperation you feel when a pet is sick. If you go there for an emergency, I would recommend only stabilizing your pet and seeking a second opinion before authorizing any tests or paying for them in advance.

SEEK A SECOND OPINION, and if it's urgent, just have your pet stabilized, but don't pay for any tests.

And I know you'll want to justify your actions, but I'll be back with more updates because I don't want more people to lose their money.
Super cute for bathing our little dog!

I took Badrak, my Belgian Shepherd puppy, to the emergency vet for a gastric problem, and they immediately detected a foreign object in his intestine. The diagnostic procedures were very accurate, and all the instructions regarding what to do during and after the procedure were clear and in writing. The care was excellent in terms of both protocols and treatment.
Something I greatly appreciated was the transparency regarding the costs of the procedure; there were no "surprise" charges, and I was always informed in advance of any potential additional expenses.
I thank all the emergency room staff and the regular staff for their professionalism and kindness.

Our experience at Hospivet has been excellent. We arrived for an emergency in the early morning and have returned because of the care we received. They are always kind and make us feel very calm.

We are currently under the care of ophthalmologist Ana Paola and have noticed remarkable progress with our dog. She is always clear and shares the expected prognoses, which gives us a clear picture and helps us manage our expectations.

The check-up appointments, grooming services, and vaccinations also offer specialized and professional care.
The vet was very patient, explained everything in detail, and treated my dog ​​with dignity.

💙 Thank you so much for your 5-star rating, Diego! We're so glad you think we offer reasonable prices. We strive to provide quality veterinary care at fair and transparent costs for our patients and their families. 🐾✨ Thank you for your trust! 💙 …
Excellent service
Good service because during the consultation they took an x-ray to clearly visualize the problem, and the explanation was quite thorough to understand the whole issue.

My experience wasn't good, and thankfully, I decided to get a second opinion before making such an important decision.

I took my West Highland White Terrier in because he was having gastrointestinal problems. After the ultrasound, they told me he needed surgery to take biopsies and rule out lymphoma or inflammatory bowel disease, implying that surgery was the next step.

Before having him operated on, I decided to seek a second opinion from a veterinary gastroenterologist at Centro Veterinario México. They reviewed the case again, started a treatment plan, and after follow-up, my dog ​​has improved significantly. The specialist now believes he doesn't need surgery.

My intention with this review isn't to discredit anyone, but rather to encourage other pet owners to always seek a second opinion when they're offered an invasive procedure like surgery. Our dogs are part of our family, and surgery is not a minor decision.

Personally, I felt that surgery was considered too soon, without first exhausting all medical alternatives. Fortunately, I sought a second opinion, and that completely changed the course of Monet's treatment.

The reception staff are incredibly friendly! Which is much appreciated. From what I saw, they have several specialists like ophthalmologists, cardiologists, internists, etc. This is a huge help because specialty hospitals are often full.
It's an excellent option!
I did find the price a bit high, but otherwise, it's fantastic! 👍
Excellent service and attention from the doctor and the marketing girl 🤗 …
Dr. Ana Paola Margay is excellent. Not a 10 out of 12.

Excellent service! From the moment we arrived, the reception staff were very friendly and attentive.
We went in for an eye problem, and Ana Pao saw us. She explained everything very well and took wonderful care of Maya. A great doctor with patience, dedication, and a real love for what she does (something you hardly ever see anymore).
We will definitely be back, and I'll bring my other pets too!
Good service and diagnosis, it's busy and you need to make an appointment.

Excellent service and care from Dr. Javier Sotres. He was very kind, responsible, attentive, and compassionate. I highly recommend his care at this hospital. Thank you so much, Dr. 😊, for taking care of Sirius 😭💝💖🌟✨⚡💫🫰🤘🫵⭐🌟✨🙏 …
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating and for sharing your opinion! 💙 …

Words cannot express our gratitude for the love, dedication, and professionalism with which our little Appa has been cared for. All the staff have provided exceptional care, but we want to give a very special thank you to Dr. Praxedis. Thanks to his commitment, expertise, and compassion, Appa's quality of life has improved in a way that fills us with hope and joy.

Thank you for treating him with so much love and for being with us throughout this process. We will always be deeply grateful for everything you have done for our little one. ❤️🐾

A wonderful service. They were very attentive from the moment I called. Dr. Ana Paola Margay is very professional. She examined Mika's eyes, my dog, with great care and patience, using all the necessary equipment and techniques for each part of her eye. She explained everything to me on a sheet of paper, making me feel like I was in a classroom.
She was incredibly attentive and accurate. She didn't scare the client at all; quite the opposite. I highly recommend both Hospivet del Valle and especially the ophthalmologist, Dr. Ana Paola Margay. 😊 10 out of 10.

Hi Zoe. We're sorry your experience wasn't what you expected.
We'd like to learn more about what happened so we can follow up on your case and find a solution. If you share your name or contact us directly, we'd be happy to review your experience.

Thank you so much for your rating, Patricia! We're here to serve you! 🐾💙⭐

 …
I liked Dr. Ana Paola; she explained everything in detail, which makes her seem like a doctor with professional ethics and very kind.

Laura is the best! I highly recommend the grooming and aesthetics department at Hospivet. Leaving your pet with someone is always a little nerve-wracking, but Laura inspires complete confidence from the very first moment. She treats them with such care and professionalism. My dog ​​looked beautiful, clean, and, most importantly, very well cared for. If you're looking for top-notch service, ask for her.
I took my dog ​​Nala for a check-up and I loved the service from the doctor and the telephone support from Miss Pamela; the information was very thorough.

I had an emergency with my dog ​​Benji. Benji has a history that has made him very reactive with other dogs. They made us feel very safe, they took incredible care of Benji, and the treatment was incredibly kind. I am very grateful to Dr. Pablo and the receptionist. This will definitely be my go-to place for my little guy. Thank you for everything 🙏🏼
Excellent service and facilities, as well as a great explanation from Dr. Ana Paola Margay Aragón

I've had good experiences with them before, like with the grooming services or some of the doctors, but that hasn't been the case lately. I'm not sure what the problem is, but I feel like they care more about money than my dog's health. They ordered the wrong tests, gave me a consultation, and his discomfort didn't go away. Sometimes one doctor at the same hospital tells me one thing, and then another tells me something completely different, and every time we see a new doctor, we have to start all over again.
The costs seem very high lately, and in the end, I paid for the last consultation, and they didn't solve any of my dog's problems. Anyway, I hope the service improves because I think there are some things that are worthwhile, and I feel like those are becoming fewer and fewer...
Excellent service and you can tell they are well-trained veterinarians, kind and careful with the animals.
Thank you so much for your rating, Alfonso! We're here to serve you! 🐾💙⭐ …

Thank you for your rating, Selene! 💙
Your rating means a lot to us and motivates us to keep improving. We hope to have the opportunity to serve you and your little one again soon. 🐾 …

Thank you so much for your rating, Kiko! We're here to serve you! 🐾💙⭐

 …

A great place, they take amazing care of your dog and love them like they're their own, 100% recommended!!!
Dr. Rodrigo is also very kind and intelligent!!

We came because my little one was sick; a tumor was detected, and he had surgery, but unfortunately, due to his age, his little body couldn't withstand it. Everyone, from reception to doctors (especially Dr. Daniel), treated my little one with super professionalism and a lot of affection from the moment he arrived. The times we went to visit him because he was hospitalized, I saw doctors giving caresses and speaking lovingly to the little ones who were also hospitalized.

I took my dog ​​because he was showing symptoms that worried us a lot, and the experience was quite bad. From the beginning, the service felt unprofessional and lacked empathy. First, an assistant took his medical history, and then the veterinarian did the exact same thing again, as if there was no communication between them.

Furthermore, when they took his temperature rectally, they did it twice and ended up hurting him, which I found very careless, especially considering he was already feeling unwell. In general, the attitude was very listless, as if they were just going through the motions and not providing the care a pet deserves.

The worst part is that, despite the poor service and leaving more worried than reassured, the cost was not proportional to the quality of the consultation. At the very least, one expects professionalism, coordination, and dignified treatment for their pet.

I wouldn't go back, and I definitely wouldn't recommend it. When you take your pet there worried, you expect support and confidence, not to leave with the feeling that they were treated hastily, with disinterest, and roughly.
Amazing service, Penny loves the doctors

Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Yessy. 💙🐾
If you'd like to share more details about your visit, we'd be happy to hear from you and follow up on any issues. Thank you for helping us continue to grow and improve every day. …
Thank you so much for your rating, Julio! We're here to serve you! 🐾💙⭐ …

They provide good medical care and have a grooming service for dogs and cats. However, the problem is that follow-up care is handled through reception. If you have any questions or want to report your pet's health status, you have to leave a message with whoever answers the phone. They supposedly pass the message on to the doctor, who never responds until you return for a follow-up appointment.
In my personal experience, the doctor didn't remember ever treating my pet.
Exorbitant prices and yet the secretaries are terrible, rude and arrogant, they all say "the new management doesn't allow it anymore"... Before they had better quality, service and attention...

Excellent service from the moment we walked in; prompt and very good attention. My dog ​​and I are very grateful to the entire team (staff) and especially to Dr. Ana Paola Margay A., who answered all my questions and whose explanations of the case were clear and precise, in addition to being very patient with us.
Excellent service, they are extremely professional and provide comprehensive care. They take great care of our furry friends.
It is a remarkably humanitarian hospital with ethical doctors who offer timely and accurate diagnoses.

Thank you so much for your rating, Liliana! We're here to serve you! 🐾💙⭐

 …

Thank you so much for your rating, Stephanie! We're here to serve you! 🐾💙⭐

 …
They were very kind and attended to my dog ​​quickly in the emergency room.

This is the first place where my Rottweiler feels calm, comfortable, and happy.

I took Iká there for an emergency, and the doctors were very kind to me and treated my dog ​​very well.

The reception staff are very friendly, even when they're busy.

I highly recommend their pet grooming services.

Thank you so much for your 5 stars, Luz María! 🐾💙⭐

 …
We apologize if your experience at HOSPIVET, Victoria was not satisfactory. We appreciate your feedback, as it helps us continue improving our services. 💙 …

The only star I'm giving is for the kindness of the staff, especially the receptionists, who were always attentive and compassionate.

However, I want to remind the doctors (if there was a plural) involved in Camilo's case that humility is essential in medicine, and that arrogance can become very dangerous when a life is at stake.
I took my dog ​​in because I noticed something wasn't right. At that time, he didn't have a specific symptom, but there were clear signs that something was wrong. I never refused any tests, never delayed appointments or sample collection, and despite the stress and uncertainty, I always waited patiently for the results.
Today, after three weeks, Hospivet still hasn't given my dog ​​a diagnosis. The only response I get is to run more tests, but without a clear plan, without a concrete diagnostic approach, and with the constant justification that "it's all part of the diagnostic process" and that it COULD be a thousand different things. Meanwhile, my dog ​​lost 2 kg and showed no improvement.

The hospital claims to have various specialties, but at no point did I perceive any real interdisciplinary work or collaboration among colleagues to analyze the case comprehensively and explore alternatives.
It's clear to me that they studied veterinary medicine, because every conversation was filled with medical jargon; terms that I had to research and translate myself with the help of AI to understand what was happening. What I never found was clear clinical experience, empathy, or medical humility; there was no clinical experience to explain things in a humane and transparent way.

I fully understand that this is a business, but it's also the field of animal health. You're not dealing with cars or replaceable parts; you're dealing with lives and families who place their trust, time, money, and emotional stability in you.
Today, I finally know what Camilo has, and it wasn't thanks to this hospital, and it was definitely FAR from the assumptions mentioned by the doctor. If any pet owner has come this far and suspects their companion has a complex case, I honestly want to save them anguish, emotional strain, and money: this is not the place.

On the other hand, if they need something simple like vaccinations, basic checkups, or specialized food, they can probably find it here without any problem. I'm leaving deeply disappointed, frustrated, and angry. I trusted this place expecting guidance, clarity, and professional support, and I ended up feeling alone throughout the process. For that reason, I had to seek a second opinion elsewhere: a place where at least there was a willingness to develop a plan, offer alternatives, and speak honestly and with medical backing.
They're open 24/7 for emergencies 👍🏼 …
Excellent beauty service with Javier

I had many problems with my dog, who sadly passed away at the hospital.

A complete lack of respect and sensitivity.

My experience at this hospital was deeply disappointing. I went seeking professional care for a geriatric case, but unfortunately, I perceived a lack of experience in managing this type of patient.

During the consultation, the problem could not be identified. Subsequently, I went to another veterinarian where, through a physical examination, the doctor immediately identified the possible cause and confirmed it with an X-ray, which demonstrated a significant difference in clinical judgment.

Additionally, at this hospital, I was sold a product costing $2,000 pesos that did not correspond to the condition that was ultimately diagnosed, which raises concerns about the accuracy of the recommendations provided.

I also requested that information be forwarded to the veterinarian for follow-up and to resolve important questions; however, more than 24 hours have passed without a response. The lack of communication and follow-up leaves a clear impression of disinterest after the service was completed.

The cost was high, which naturally generates high expectations regarding quality, care, and support. In this case, those expectations were not met. Beyond the financial aspect, the lack of empathy for the patients' pain and the concerns of their owners is troubling.

In contrast, the other place I went to not only performed a proper evaluation but also followed up on the case, even contacting me later to check on my dog's progress.

Truly professional care doesn't end with payment; it continues with follow-up and commitment to each case.

I'd like to share my experience so it doesn't happen to you. My dog ​​was diagnosed with skin cancer, and I went to this hospital because they claim to be "oncology specialists." At that time, my dog ​​had a small, open, bleeding ulcer caused by the cancer. A general practitioner saw him and ran all the tests. Up to that point, everything seemed fine. They cleaned the ulcer and told me they needed the results and the doctor's opinion for follow-up.

Several days passed, and they didn't tell me what the next steps would be or how long the tests would take. I had to keep sending messages to check the status and practically beg them to send the results. Almost a month went by, and out of four tests, they only gave me three. They kept ignoring my messages and giving me the runaround. They finally sent the results in the middle of the night after I insisted. The oncologist never had appointments (and I'm not talking about her vacation time). My dog's ulcer kept getting bigger, and I mentioned it, but they continued to be negligent.

The final straw was that I had already managed to make an appointment with the oncologist, and she canceled at the last minute. They had made me confirm the appointment the day before, only to reschedule it for a week later. After I had already mentioned that my dog's ulcer was growing and still bleeding, they told me there were no doctors available to see him and that to make a new appointment I had to make a deposit to "confirm" with another doctor, even though they were the ones who had canceled.

In short, I had to insist to get the ultrasound so I wouldn't have to repeat the tests. They NEVER scheduled a follow-up appointment or sent me the doctor's interpretation of the results. I don't think it takes a month and a half for them to send the results, especially since it's not the first time they've done them. I took my dog ​​to another hospital specializing in oncology, and fortunately, he's receiving treatment there.

In short, if you need something simple, I think they have good facilities and doctors; however, their customer service is terrible, and definitely, if you need tests and specialists, at least in oncology, DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME and take them somewhere else.

They're just profiting off animals. I deeply regret having trusted their services so much and wasting valuable time for my baby. I'd like to know what PROFECO (the Mexican consumer protection agency) would think about the bad practices at this place. Talking to acquaintances, it turns out this isn't an isolated incident.
